vocabulary:a-little-bit.title: a little bit：有一点、稍微
vocabulary:a-little-bit.explanation: 程度副词，表示“略微、一点点”，用于弱化语气、让表达更柔和口语化，常修饰形容词、动词或不可数名词。口语高频；书面正式表达更常用 a little / slightly。
vocabulary:a-little-bit.source: We'll talk about that a little bit later on.
vocabulary:a-little-bit.example: I'm a little bit tired today. / 我今天有点累。

vocabulary:across-preposition-adverb-vs-.title: across 与 cross：介词/副词和动词的区别
vocabulary:across-preposition-adverb-vs-.explanation: across 通常作介词或副词，表示从一边到另一边，作介词时后接名词，如 walk across the bridge；cross 是动词，直接接宾语，如 cross the bridge。不能说 cross across the bridge，除非 across 属于另一个独立结构。
vocabulary:across-preposition-adverb-vs-.source: The old bridge across the river. / The old bridge crosses the river.
vocabulary:across-preposition-adverb-vs-.example: We walked across the bridge, and then we crossed the street.

vocabulary:afterwards-afterward-spelling.title: afterwards（英式）与 afterward（美式）
vocabulary:afterwards-afterward-spelling.explanation: 同一副词在英式英语常写 afterwards，美式英语常写 afterward；两者都可以独立作状语、置于句首或句末，不需要补足语。
vocabulary:afterwards-afterward-spelling.source: We went out for dinner afterwards.
vocabulary:afterwards-afterward-spelling.example: We went out for dinner afterwards.

vocabulary:back-east-in-the-east-eastwar.title: back east、in the East 与 eastward 的区别
vocabulary:back-east-in-the-east-eastwar.explanation: back east 带有从当前所在地回望美国东部原居地或熟悉地区的意味；in the East 只客观说明位于某个东部地区；eastward 强调朝东的移动或方向，通常不表达故乡联系。
vocabulary:back-east-in-the-east-eastwar.example: After living in California for years, she traveled eastward to visit her family back east.

vocabulary:boat-small-watercraft.title: boat：小船 / 船
vocabulary:boat-small-watercraft.explanation: boat 是日常词，通常指尺寸较小、可用于休闲、渡水或短途航行的船。在 sailing 语境里，boat 可以泛指要开出去的帆船或小艇。
vocabulary:boat-small-watercraft.source: Shall we take the boat out this morning?
vocabulary:boat-small-watercraft.example: We rented a small boat for the afternoon.

vocabulary:breeze-light-wind.title: breeze：微风
vocabulary:breeze-light-wind.explanation: breeze 指轻柔、舒服的风，比 wind 更具体、更温和。在海边或户外活动中，a nice breeze 常表示天气宜人，也适合帆船借风航行。
vocabulary:breeze-light-wind.example: A cool breeze came in from the sea.

vocabulary:casserole.title: casserole（砂锅；用砂锅做的整锅炖菜／焗菜）
vocabulary:casserole.explanation: 两层含义：①带盖的耐热深锅（陶、玻璃、珐琅铸铁）；②用这种锅做出来的一整锅菜。英美分工：英式更常指炉上或烤箱慢炖的混合菜；美式更常指食材加酱汁拌匀后送烤箱焗烤、表面撒面包屑或奶酪的「焗菜」。指器皿时更常说 casserole dish；中文「砂锅」偏明火陶锅炖煮，强调容器可用 clay pot / sand pot。作动词极罕见（词典收录 to casserole「放进砂锅烹制」，日常几乎不用）。词源：法语 casserole（平底锅）← casse ← 普罗旺斯语 cassa ← 中世纪拉丁语 cattia（锅、勺），更早与希腊语 kyathion（小勺）相关。
vocabulary:casserole.example: She brought a chicken-and-rice casserole to the potluck.

vocabulary:cover-deal-with.title: cover（应付、处理、足以涵盖）
vocabulary:cover-deal-with.explanation: 动词 cover 除「覆盖」外，口语/商务中常表示「处理得了、足以应付或涵盖」。如 cover the cost（承担费用）、cover the basics（覆盖基础事项）。
vocabulary:cover-deal-with.example: This budget covers all travel expenses. 这笔预算涵盖所有差旅费用。

vocabulary:distinct-adj.title: distinct — 不同的、独特的、明显的
vocabulary:distinct-adj.explanation: 形容词。此处强调“彼此不同、各自独立、可以区分开来”的意思，比 different 更强，暗示这些群体之间有明显可辨的差异或独立性。也可表“清晰明显的”（如 a distinct smell）。
vocabulary:distinct-adj.example: The two languages are distinct in sound and structure. 这两种语言在语音和结构上都截然不同。

vocabulary:drizzle-light-rain.title: drizzle 表示毛毛雨或下毛毛雨
vocabulary:drizzle-light-rain.explanation: drizzle 可作名词，表示很细、很轻、持续落下的小雨；也可作动词，表示下毛毛雨。它比 rain 更轻，比 shower 更细碎、持续感更强。
vocabulary:drizzle-light-rain.example: It started to drizzle on my way home. 我回家路上开始下毛毛雨了。

vocabulary:drizzle-rain-shower.title: drizzle、rain 和 shower 的语感区别
vocabulary:drizzle-rain-shower.explanation: drizzle 强调雨很细很轻；rain 是最普通的下雨说法；shower 常指短时间的一阵雨。描述天气时，drizzle 往往带有潮湿、灰蒙蒙、轻微但持续的感觉。
vocabulary:drizzle-rain-shower.example: There was a light drizzle all morning. 整个早上都下着小毛毛雨。

vocabulary:early-bird.title: early bird 早起的人
vocabulary:early-bird.explanation: 指习惯早起、清晨状态最好的人；源自谚语 The early bird catches the worm（早起的鸟儿有虫吃）。
vocabulary:early-bird.source: Are you a night owl or an early bird?
vocabulary:early-bird.example: He's an early bird, so he finishes his workout before breakfast.

vocabulary:ethnic-group.title: ethnic group — 族群、民族
vocabulary:ethnic-group.explanation: 指拥有共同文化、语言、历史或血缘认同的人群。常以复数 ethnic groups 出现，用于讨论一个国家的民族构成。China 通常说有 56 个民族（ethnic groups / nationalities）。
vocabulary:ethnic-group.example: China is home to 56 ethnic groups, including the Han majority. 中国有 56 个民族，其中汉族占多数。

vocabulary:gonna.title: gonna — going to 的口语缩略形式
vocabulary:gonna.explanation: gonna 是 going to 的口语拼写形式，表示「打算 / 将要」，美音读 /ˈɡɑːnə/。它本身已经包含 to，所以不能说 gonna to do。正式写作、考试作文里必须写 going to。
vocabulary:gonna.example: I'm gonna grab a coffee before class.（上课前我去买杯咖啡。）

vocabulary:harbor-place-for-boats.title: harbor：港口 / 避风港
vocabulary:harbor-place-for-boats.explanation: harbor 指船只停靠、避风或装卸的地方。在日常航海、旅行语境中，它常指码头附近受保护的水域。
vocabulary:harbor-place-for-boats.source: Let's meet at the harbor at ten.
vocabulary:harbor-place-for-boats.example: The small boats were tied up in the harbor.

vocabulary:hidden-adjective.title: hidden — 隐藏的、未被发现的
vocabulary:hidden-adjective.explanation: 形容词，来自动词 hide（藏）。比 secret 更侧重“客观看不见/鲜为人知”，是纪录片、旅游与探险文案里营造“秘境感”的高频词。
vocabulary:hidden-adjective.example: A hidden valley untouched by tourists. → 一处未被游客踏足的隐秘山谷。

vocabulary:mind-numbing.title: mind-numbing (adj.) 冷到麻木的/令人麻木的
vocabulary:mind-numbing.explanation: 复合形容词，结构为名词 mind + 现在分词 numbing（numb 使麻木），口语带夸张色彩；mind-numbing cold 指冷到失去知觉。同类结构：heart-breaking、breath-taking、time-saving。
vocabulary:mind-numbing.source: Vast deserts ranging from searing hot to mind-numbing cold.
vocabulary:mind-numbing.example: The mind-numbing cold of the desert night caught them off guard.（沙漠夜晚彻骨的寒冷让他们措手不及。）

vocabulary:night-owl.title: night owl 夜猫子
vocabulary:night-owl.explanation: 指习惯晚睡、夜里精力最旺盛的人，名词短语，非贬义，口语常用。
vocabulary:night-owl.source: Are you a night owl or an early bird?
vocabulary:night-owl.example: My roommate is a real night owl; she often studies until 2 a.m.

vocabulary:plate-as-verb-arrange-food.title: plate 作动词：摆盘
vocabulary:plate-as-verb-arrange-food.explanation: plate 作动词时通常指把食物放到盘子上并摆放得好看，常见于厨师、餐厅或烹饪节目语境，比 dish up 更强调外观和呈现。
vocabulary:plate-as-verb-arrange-food.example: The chef plated the dessert with fresh berries.

vocabulary:range.title: range（范围；一系列/种类）
vocabulary:range.explanation: 作名词表示'范围、系列、种类'，常与 of 连用构成 a range of... 与 variety 的区别：range 侧重覆盖面的广与范围，variety 侧重类型之间的多样性；多数场景可互换。
vocabulary:range.example: This course covers a broad range of topics. 这门课涵盖范围很广的话题。

vocabulary:review-core-meaning.title: review 的核心含义
vocabulary:review-core-meaning.explanation: review 作动词表示复习、审查或回顾，作名词表示复习、审查、评论；具体含义由语境决定。
vocabulary:review-core-meaning.example: I need to review my notes before the exam.

vocabulary:searing.title: searing (adj.) 灼热的
vocabulary:searing.explanation: searing 源自动词 sear（灼烧、烤焦表面），作形容词表示极热、滚烫，常搭配 searing heat，比 hot 更有画面感，强调热到像被火灼。
vocabulary:searing.source: Vast deserts ranging from searing hot to mind-numbing cold.
vocabulary:searing.example: The searing afternoon heat made the pavement too hot to touch.（炙热的午后把路面晒得烫手。）

vocabulary:slice-cut-into-thin-pieces.title: slice：切成片
vocabulary:slice-cut-into-thin-pieces.explanation: slice 强调把食物切成薄片或片状，常搭配 bread、tomatoes、onions、meat 等；名词 slice 也可表示“一片”。
vocabulary:slice-cut-into-thin-pieces.example: Slice the tomatoes before you make the salad.

vocabulary:stand-bear-put-up-with.title: stand / bear / put up with / tolerate 近义辨析
vocabulary:stand-bear-put-up-with.explanation: stand 表“忍受”几乎只用于否定或疑问句；bear 语气更强、更书面；put up with 口语化、表“容忍”；tolerate 最正式。肯定句中要表达“忍受”时优先用 bear 或 put up with。
vocabulary:stand-bear-put-up-with.source: I cannot stand the smell of smoke.
vocabulary:stand-bear-put-up-with.example: How can you put up with that noise every day?

vocabulary:steaming-steam-adj.title: steaming：雾气蒸腾的、热气腾腾的
vocabulary:steaming-steam-adj.explanation: steaming 是动词 steam 的现在分词，用作形容词，形容潮湿闷热环境中不断冒出水汽的状态，常用于描述热带雨林、刚出锅食物等。作形容词时比 steamy 更强调「正在冒热气/水汽蒸腾」的动态画面。
vocabulary:steaming-steam-adj.source: The hiking trail wound through the steaming forests of the Amazon.
vocabulary:steaming-steam-adj.example: We sat down to a plate of steaming dumplings.

vocabulary:stir-mix-by-moving-spoon.title: stir：搅拌
vocabulary:stir-mix-by-moving-spoon.explanation: stir 指用勺子或类似工具搅动液体、糊状物或锅里的食物，让材料混合或受热均匀；常见搭配是 stir the soup、stir the sauce。
vocabulary:stir-mix-by-moving-spoon.example: Stir the soup for a few minutes.

vocabulary:traveller-traveler-spelling.title: traveller（英式）vs traveler（美式）双写 l 规则
vocabulary:traveller-traveler-spelling.explanation: traveller 是英式拼写，traveler 是美式拼写。规则：英式英语在 travel 加 -er/-ing 时常双写 l（traveller, travelling），美式英语不双写（traveler, traveling）。句中 travellers 属英式写法。
vocabulary:traveller-traveler-spelling.example: US: I'm a frequent traveler. / UK: I'm a frequent traveller. (我是一个经常旅行的人。)

vocabulary:vast.title: vast (adj.) 广袤的、巨大的
vocabulary:vast.explanation: vast 强调极其广大、无边无际，比 huge 更适合修饰沙漠、海洋、平原等大空间；常见搭配 vast desert / territory / area。
vocabulary:vast.source: Vast deserts ranging from searing hot to mind-numbing cold.
vocabulary:vast.example: A vast desert stretched to the horizon.（一片广袤的沙漠延伸到天边。）
